name: Airwindows
pre_build: cd deps/airwin2rack && (git apply --check ../../scripts/patches/airwin_no_skip_empty.patch 2>/dev/null && git apply ../../scripts/patches/airwin_no_skip_empty.patch || true)

[ -f build-wasm/libairwin-registry.a ] || (emcmake cmake -S deps/airwin2rack -B build-wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-pthread -fPIC' -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='-pthread -fPIC' >/dev/null && cmake --build build-wasm --target airwin-registry -j8 >/dev/null)

mkdir -p wasm-plugins && em++ -O2 -pthread -fPIC -std=c++17 -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -DNDEBUG -include /w/compat/include/schwung_module_prelude.h -include /w/compat/wasm_compat.h scripts/airwindows_clap_wrapper.cpp -I deps/airwin2rack/src -I third_party/clap/include -sSIDE_MODULE=1 build-wasm/libairwin-registry.a build-wasm/libawdoc_resources.a -o wasm-plugins/Airwindows.clap
upstream_build: scripts/build.sh: g++ -O3 -std=c++14 -fno-exceptions -DNDEBUG clap_fx.cpp category_browser.c clap_host.c -Isrc -Isrc/dsp -Isrc/chain_audio_fx -Ithird_party/clap/include -ldl -> clap.so; scripts/build_airwindows_clap.sh: airwin2rack (patched airwin_no_skip_empty) cmake target airwin-registry + airwindows_clap_wrapper.cpp -> plugins/Airwindows.clap; dist/clap/{module.json,help.json,clap.so,plugins/*.clap,LICENSE,LICENSES/*}
wasm_notes: The committed plugins/Airwindows.clap is an aarch64 ELF, so it is rebuilt from airwin2rack (pinned) as a second Emscripten side module at the same path; clap_host.c dlopen()s it at runtime from <module_dir>/plugins.
